controls.name: ordinaryBurstBounded
controls.description: Fixed 4 burst callers for the same callGroupId bounded to at most 2 native reads via coalescing
controls.synchronization: Deterministic barrier gate held on listRooms pass 1 until callers 2, 3, 4 are queued in pendingOrdinary
assertions: Promise.all([t1, t2, t3, t4]) resolves successfully

controls.name: differentGroupsIndependent
controls.description: Concurrent reconcileGroup requests for distinct callGroupId1 and callGroupId2 execute independent passes
controls.synchronization: Unbounded parallel dispatch across distinct group IDs

controls.name: triggerWhileTrailingNoLostWakeup
controls.description: A trigger arriving while a trailing pass is already executing initiates a third pass without lost wakeup
controls.synchronization: Two-phase deterministic barrier (pass 1 gate followed by trailing pass 2 gate)

controls.name: distinctEndedProcessedIndividually
controls.description: Distinct ended events with specific {identity, at} payloads each execute an individual canonical reconcilePass
controls.synchronization: Concurrent dispatch of distinct ended payloads

controls.name: exactErrorObjectPreservedAndRecovery
controls.description: Injected synthetic error instance is propagated unchanged to all concurrent callers and clears for subsequent recovery
controls.synchronization: Concurrent dispatch during faulted native client state

controls.name: shutdownDrainsAcceptedAndRejectsNew
controls.description: onModuleDestroy drains all previously accepted ordinary and ended jobs to completion before closing database pool, while rejecting new incoming calls with 503
controls.synchronization: Deterministic barrier holding pass 1 while job 2 and ended job queue, then triggering onModuleDestroy
assertions: new call rejected with status 503 or message containing 'shutting down'
all accepted jobs (drainJob1, drainJob2, drainJobEnded) resolve to completion
pool.end is invoked strictly after all accepted jobs finish

controls.name: signedDuplicateWebhookReconciles
controls.description: Duplicate signed webhook payloads are recognized and processed idempotently
controls.synchronization: Sequential webhook dispatch with identical payload ID
